EARLIER SCENES (context only):
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子的妈妈觉得孟子取得良好的教育是很重要的，所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好，就打算跟孟子搬家。孟子的妈妈带孟子不是搬到城市，而是搬到了孟子老师的家。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P32] 孟子的妈妈觉得孟子【取得】良好的教育是很重要的
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子的妈妈觉得孟子[取得→接受]良好的教育是很重要的 (取得 does not collocate with 教育; one receives education)
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子的妈妈觉得孟子[取得→受到]良好的教育是很重要的
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 孟母一直觉得[受到→接受]教育很重要
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟母一直想[+让]她的孩子受到良好的教育 — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 孟子的妈妈[不是轻松的妈妈，而且她是厉害的妈妈→在教育方面很厉害] — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P33] 所以孟子【的】妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好
  proposed by the correction model: 所以孟子[-的]妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 可是孟子的妈妈[有别的看法→就抱怨] — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction (redundant_words): 最后孟母觉得不是孟子不好[-的男孩]
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P34] 所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子【的教育】不太好
  proposed by the correction model: 所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子[-的教育]不太好
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈一直[想她的儿子在很好的地方长大→想让她的儿子在很好的地方长大] — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  her past correction (redundant_words): 最后孟母觉得不是孟子不好[-的男孩]
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P35] 就打算【跟】孟子搬家
  proposed by the correction model: 就打算[跟→让]孟子搬家
  her past correction (haide_harmful_result): 这个想法⟦害得她跟孟子搬家⟧ — her note: 害得+harmful result, 搬家itself is not harmful
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 孟子才三岁[+就]开始搬家 — her note: 才Num.就V.
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 现在孟子和孟母不[-是]打算搬家 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  rule card haide_harmful_result: Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得. Not an error: Do not use this rule for a neutral event such as 搬家 or 玩儿, or for a merely mild feeling such as 不高兴; these are not harmful results for 害得.
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.

[P36] 孟子的妈妈【^】带孟子不是搬到城市
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子的妈妈[+不是]带孟子不是搬到城市
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-孟子跟他的妈妈]已经搬家了
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.
  rule card addition_repetition_connectors: Use 又 for something that happened again, 也 for similarity, 还 for an added or surprising point, and 并 to make an addition more coherent. Put 也 after the subject (Subj.也), and put 又 before a modal V. (又+ modal V.). Not an error: Do not add an additive connector when the sentence does not show repetition, similarity, or an added point. Use 就, not 还, for a natural continuation rather than a surprising or angry one.

[P37] 孟子的妈妈带孟子【不是】搬到城市
  proposed by the AI checker: 孟子的妈妈带孟子[不是→没有]搬到城市 (completed negative action needs 没有 rather than 不是)
  proposed by the correction model: 孟子的妈妈带孟子[-不是]搬到城市
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction (near_synonym_precision): 所以妈妈[跟孟子一起→带孟子]搬家

Put 也 after the subject (Subj.也), and put 又 before a modal V. (又+ modal V.). Not an error: Do not add an additive connector when the sentence does not show repetition, similarity, or an added point. Use 就, not 还, for a natural continuation rather than a surprising or angry one.

places.reason: 取得 does not naturally collocate with 教育.
孟子的妈妈 is a natural possessive phrase.
对儿子的教育不太好 is natural and adds the relevant meaning.
跟孟子搬家 naturally means moving together with Mencius.
No additional 不是 is needed; it would create an error.
不是…而是… is a valid contrast between destinations/actions here.
